text:
Maya (CS Ops): quick request — can Enablement emit a completion webhook so CS can: 1) auto-create an activity, 2) enqueue follow-up task for owner, and 3) adjust healthscore by curriculum impact (not a flat +10).
Diego (Eng Backend): yep. preference: POST to /webhooks/enablement-complete on ops-api. want it to be idempotent and signed.
Maya (CS Ops): payload should include account_id, contact_id, training_key, curriculum_tag, nps (if given), free_text_feedback, and a flag indicating whether this was instructor-led or self-serve. Also we want training_duration_minutes and curriculum_version.
Priya (Product): product asks that instead of a fixed +10 we send back a recommended health_delta (e.g., +0.12 for 12% increase toward healthy) based on curriculum_tag + nps, and CS platform will apply it subject to gating rules. We need curriculum_tag canonical names.
Sam (CS Manager): gating rules: 1) mark account with tag enablement.received, 2) schedule health_delta application after 14 days unless a negative signal (billing_issue, downgrade_event, active_risk) appears, 3) if NPS >=9 and feedback contains keywords like "extremely" or "love" then escalate owner task to priority.
Diego (Eng Backend): plan: X-RW-Signature HMAC, X-RW-Idempotency header. idempotency = sha256(account_id + training_key + event_ts). support signature rotation header X-RW-Signature-V2. sample payload below:
```
POST /webhooks/enablement-complete
Headers: X-RW-Signature: sha256=..., X-RW-Idempotency: <id>
{
  "account_id": "acct_77x",
  "contact_id": "contact_009",
  "training_key": "core-onboarding-2026",
  "training_name": "Core Platform - Live",
  "curriculum_tag": "onboarding_core",
  "curriculum_version": "v1.4",
  "delivery_mode": "instructor_led",
  "nps": 10,
  "free_text_feedback": "Loved the deployment examples, made it easy to integrate",
  "training_duration_minutes": 60,
  "event_ts": "2026-03-21T17:12:00Z"
}
```
Maya (CS Ops): when webhook arrives: 1) create CRM activity type "Enablement Complete" with note = feedback + training_name + who submitted, 2) attach tag enablement.received, 3) push follow-up task to owner with link to account and suggested next step ("share onboarding guide v1.4"). If contact has opt_out_contact=true do not write to external CRM but keep internal log.
Priya (Product): add field recommended_health_delta (stringified decimal) if Enablement wants to pre-compute it (optional). We'll still respect gating. Also include instructor_id if available.
Diego (Eng Backend): admin endpoints: backfill route `/admin/backfill/enablement?days=60&dry_run=true`. CSV columns: account_id, contact_id, owner_id, owner_email, received_ts, nps, training_key, curriculum_tag, opt_out_contact. Backfill will honor idempotency to avoid double-applying.
Sam (CS Manager): 60 days is enough for our early adopters. please include owner_email for prioritization and a column `recommended_action` (auto-populated: outreach, doc-share, no-action).
Maya (CS Ops): audit requirements: every webhook should produce an audit entry with meta.source=enablement, meta.idempotency_key, and raw_payload_ref. Also want a short sha256 sample in PR to validate signature locally.
Diego (Eng Backend): timeline: PR by Wednesday EOD, internal dry-run backfill Thursday, canary rollout to org 777000 for 5 days with feature flag `ff.enable_enablement_flow`, then expand. We'll include test harness + HMAC verification script in repo.
ops-bot: Created ticket CS-2042: Enablement webhook + curriculum health mapping (assignee Diego).
Priya (Product): metric requests: NPS distribution by curriculum_tag, 30/90d renewal_risk delta for accounts with enablement.received, instructor impact delta.
Maya (CS Ops): I'll compile curriculum_tag mapping + opt-out contacts list and post here. please tag when PR is up. :thumbsup:
